description: Create a Mailchimp email CAMPAIGN DRAFT: templateId (create_mailchimp_template), subject, previewText, audienceId and optionally segmentId (part of the audience), optional name, fromName and replyTo (default: the audience's own defaults). It is created as a DRAFT and NOTHING IS SENT; the answer is Mailchimp's own row read back with its send checklist. To send or schedule it use send_mailchimp_campaign, which shows the recipient count first. Free. Needs Mailchimp connected (Connectors > Mailchimp, or connect_connector with an API key).
name: create_mailchimp_campaign
title: Create a Mailchimp campaign draft
